from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544661/attempts/14aed0dece444fbc9ee55e057cb0e219/system/state/workspace/programs/task-cdfab7d7.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # Isolated marker cells are noise: replace them with the local background/object color.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v not in (3, 4, 9):
                # The pattern is composed of regions in colors 3, 4, and 9; use nearest
                # orthogonal region color, preferring the predominant surrounding color.
                neighbors = [grid[nr][nc] for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))
                              if 0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(row) and grid[nr][nc] in (3,4,9)]
                out[r][c] = max(set(neighbors), key=neighbors.count) if neighbors else 3
    return out
''')
